description: Provider-free generic AI prompt and role catalog package for role profile versions, prompt templates, delegation triggers, section output schemas, evidence validation, termination conventions, and drift fixtures.
test_gates: prompt catalog and role profile fixtures decode without provider SDKs or live model calls
role profile versions and prompt template snapshots remain domain-neutral and provider-free
delegation trigger parse examples resolve to declared role ids
evidence validation and termination convention drift cases are deterministic fixtures

no_built_in_guarantee.statement: Leia core does not provide built-in leia-generic-ai-prompt-role-catalog handling; this provider-free package boundary owns prompt catalogs, role profiles, output schemas, evidence validation, and drift fixtures.

credentials.policy: No credentials are declared by leia-generic-ai-prompt-role-catalog; provider credentials belong only to provider-specific adapter packages behind explicit capability gates.
